normalization.tilde_convention: tilde_h(x) = conj(h(-x)); real basis => tilde_h(x) = h(-x)
normalization.convolution_convention: F_ij = h_i * tilde_h_j, supported on [-L, L]
normalization.pole_formula: G0_ij = Fhat_ij(i/2) + Fhat_ij(-i/2) = E_i^+ E_j^- + E_i^- E_j^+, E_i^± = int_0^L h_i(x) e^{±x/2} dx
normalization.pole_realspace_identity: G0_ij = int_0^L K_ij(a;L) * 2*cosh(a/2) da  (same K_ij as the prime block; equals E_i^+E_j^- + E_i^-E_j^+)
normalization.prime_formula: Gp_ij = sum_{q=p^k, log q < L} (log p / sqrt(q)) * K_ij(log q; L), K_ij(a;L) = int_0^{L-a} [h_i(x)h_j(x+a) + h_j(x)h_i(x+a)] dx
normalization.archimedean_formula: Ginf_ij(T) = (1/pi) int_0^T h_+(t) Re(conj(H_i(t;L)) H_j(t;L)) dt, one-sided frequency integral with the even/real basis
normalization.frequency_integral: one-sided (0,T], real part taken; even basis
normalization.basis_normalization: unnormalised polynomials on [0,L]: 1, q1 = x - L/2, b = x(L-x)
